meta.title: Visual Browser
meta.description: One extra door under the right Sidebar's built-in Browser: a live picture of the Chrome the Agent drives, with page tabs, real click, drag, wheel and keyboard control, its own cursor that scales with the pane, and a collapsible action log you can clear. While the Agent works, a tinted lock veil covers the picture and its clicks, scrolls and drags are drawn as ripple, arrows and a grabbing hand.
